verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Milvus ships a Python SDK (pymilvus) and an official MCP server that lets AI agents query the database via natural language, which is a form of agent-framework connectivity, but no evidence pack item explicitly documents maintained first-class connectors for LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar RAG frameworks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of LangChain/LlamaIndex integration modules, versioning/maintenance status of those connectors, and any hands-on confirmation they work as advertised.
